headline: Metals.io Issues Tokens Backed by Physical Copper Stored in Germany
summary: Metals.io launched tokens backed by 25 tonnes of physical copper stored in Germany, starting with $366,000 worth of metal to enable onchain trading for investors.
why: Tokenized commodities bridge traditional physical assets with blockchain infrastructure, potentially increasing liquidity and access for onchain investors.

impacts.name: Metals.io copper token
impacts.why: The token value is directly linked to the underlying physical copper stored in Germany.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
